intro: Left {home} with {crew} and a half-baked plan to catch {band} in {destination}.
{crew} rolled out of {home} chasing {band}. Destination: {destination}. Vibes: questionable.
The tour diary opens in {home}. {band} is playing {destination}. {crew} swears we're ready.
Someone said "it's just a few shows." We left {home} anyway — {band}, {destination}, {crew} in tow.
travel_stop: Miles logged. {city} ahead — {venue} on the calendar and nerves in the cooler.
Next stop: {city}. The lot outside {venue} already smells like hope and grilled cheese.
Rolling toward {city}. {venue} is the target. Nobody's admitting we're low on gas.
Highway hypnosis breaks at {city}. Show night at {venue}. Here we go again.

shakedown: Shakedown row: tie-dye economics and whispered setlist rumors.
The lot is alive — stickers, pins, and someone definitely overpaid for a veggie burrito.
Shakedown hustle hour. Buy low, sell high, don't make eye contact with the cops.
park: Tailgate science in the park — beers warm, theories hotter.
Pre-show park scene. Someone's lecturing strangers about song placement. Classic.
Grass, coolers, and unsolicited jam history from a guy in a bucket hat.
venue: Venue doors in sight. Security looks bored. We look suspicious.
Front gates of {venue}. Ticket check, pocket check, vibe check.
The venue looms. Either we're getting in or we're writing poetry in the parking lot.
hotel: Hotel crash — overpriced sleep before the next leg of beautiful chaos.
Checked into a hotel that smells like 1998 and broken promises.
Beds, showers, and a brief illusion that we're responsible adults.
friends_house: Couch tour stop at a friend's place. Floor space is premium real estate.
Friend's house — free crash, questionable plumbing, excellent company.
Homestretch hospitality: someone's cousin knows a guy with a pull-out sofa.

post_show: Walked out of {venue} with {songs} songs in our heads and glitter in our shoes.
Post-show at {venue} — ears ringing, pockets lighter, hearts annoyingly full.
{venue} delivered. {songs} songs deep and we're already scheming the next lot.
Show done at {venue}. Someone's crying, someone's eating, everyone's pretending we're fine.
post_show_missed: Missed {venue} but the parking lot still taught us something. Mostly humility.
Never made it inside {venue}. The story still counts — barely.
{venue} happened without us. We heard it through a fence and a broken heart.
tour_end: Tour wrapped. Last stop {venue} in {city}. {band} played, we survived, the lot wins again.
Final show at {venue}. {crew} limped home legends of mediocrity and miracle.
The run is over — {city}, {venue}, {band} in the rearview. Worth it. Probably.
Curtain call on the whole swing. {venue} sent us off right. Diary closed. For now.
go_home: Called it early. Shuffled on home from the road with receipts and regrets.
Tour cut short — headed home before the universe assigned us another day job.
We bailed on the run. The couch at home never sounded so good.
Go-home moment. The adventure pauses. The crew rep remembers.
